[{"type":"heading","text":"项目介绍"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"CirSureas combines \"Precision\" and \"Assurance,\" dedicated to bringing the science of precise temperature control from professional kitchens to every cooking enthusiast."},{"type":"paragraph","text":"We have enhanced AICOOKING multi-probe identification with assignable probe numbering, allowing you to conveniently monitor the temperature of multiple ingredients simultaneously."},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Additionally, we have upgraded the cooking log feature with photo storage, enabling you to effortlessly save and revisit your grilling parameters anytime."},{"type":"heading","text":"产品概览：温度与烹饪"},{"type":"image","text":"无线智能温度探针应用","src":"/uploads/a41ee3619cf6837bd8582a166481933b-1600.webp","layout":"wide","detail":"界面展示温度监测、烹饪预设与多探针状态。"},{"type":"heading","text":"改版方向：需求与设计策略"},{"type":"image","text":"需求拆解与设计流程","src":"/uploads/54211152dbe35fb8328e49951c3cad4d-1600.webp","layout":"wide","detail":"按交互、视觉与功能三个方向整理改版需求。"},{"type":"heading","text":"交互对比：旧版与新版"},{"type":"image","text":"界面风格和交互对比","src":"/uploads/2017bbb3deb30dd3e7cd8af0fdf74fda-1600.webp","layout":"wide","detail":"原图并列呈现旧版与新版页面及调整说明。"},{"type":"heading","text":"页面延展：完整体验"},{"type":"image","text":"更多页面展示","src":"/uploads/eb84b044034afafca87e574d4fe5ced5-1600.webp","layout":"wide","detail":"保留烹饪、设备、预设和记录相关界面的完整展示。"}]
